overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF (CWY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed seeking current income and the daily 2x leverage of the price performance of CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) CWY was launched on Apr 14, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
